decision: Support excluding osm:relation:1622298 as this named residential locality from the app catalog. This removes an unsupported shopping-centre name/large-neighborhood-footprint association; it does not claim that all land inside the source polygon is nonresidential or require deleting the original OSM data.
positiveEvidence: Two primary businesses independently locate their premises in the Colisée Soula shopping centre within El Manar2; COMAR specifically gives a first-floor address. This is positive place-type evidence, not merely a missing neighborhood search result.

The root reports personally selecting a named shopping-centre Maps card at a circular commercial building. That observation corroborates the tenant descriptions; this reviewer did not read phone captures or ledger files.

The current cached polygon represents roughly2.53km² across two independently named imadas. Those overlaps are scale/context evidence, not by themselves a reason to exclude a residential area. Combined with the positive commercial identity, they do not support labeling this whole footprint Colisée Soula.

geometryQualification.noNewGeometryComputation: No replacement shape, clipping, area reclassification or broad coverage recomputation performed.

coordinateCaveat: COMAR embeds35.5130542,11.0374401, inconsistent with its explicit2092 El Manar2/Tunis address. Its text supports commercial identity only; no coordinate from that page is adopted or certified.

sourceHistory.limitation: Relation history preserves membership of the outer way, not its coordinate history. These API responses do not establish unchanged historical or current live outer-way geometry; the catalog footprint remains independently pinned to the cached PBF and packed bytes.

implementationHold: Before any exclusion, assess actual GPS/source-selection effects and conflict/coverage changes from removing this one polygon. Preserve other rows and all existing geometry/source-coordinate inputs.
Explicitly review retirement of this singleton saved ID and how manual selections remain resolvable. Do not infer a replacement locality or copy its observation to a different identity.
Do not rename this large geometry El Manar2 or replace it with a Maps-derived polygon/point. A shopping-centre POI belongs to a different catalog scope unless separately authorized.
